question: Why do some cheese slices say "cheese product"?
notes: Narration v2. Times are seconds into voice.mp3, computed from words.json by shots.py. Each scene is one stop on the vertical paper strip. "paint" lists where the paint lands and the word it lands on.

scenes.line: Why do some cheese slices say "cheese product" on the wrapper?

art.desc: A stack of individually wrapped cheese slices, the top one half unwrapped (Short 08's last picture)

scenes.beat_note: Opens on Short 08's last picture (the thread).

scenes.line: Because of a powder from overseas, some angry dairy farmers, and the FDA.

art.desc: An open tin of white powder with a scoop: the milk protein powder
A cow at a hay rack with a milk pail: the dairy farmers

scenes.line: In America, some food names come with a recipe set by law.

art.desc: A thick old book lying open: the rules

scenes.line: To be called "cheese food," a product can only use cheese plus things like milk, cream and whey.

art.desc: Butter, a wedge of cheese, a bowl of cream: the allowed dairy ingredients

scenes.line: Kraft Singles were sold as cheese food.

art.desc: A stack of individually wrapped cheese slices, the top one half unwrapped (Short 08's last picture)

scenes.line: But Kraft was adding milk protein concentrate, a powder made by filtering milk down to its protein.

art.desc: An open tin of white powder with a scoop: the milk protein powder

scenes.line: Much of it came from overseas, and American dairy farmers wanted something done about it.

art.desc: A steamship on simple waves (Short 08): from overseas
A cow at a hay rack with a milk pail: the dairy farmers

scenes.line: That powder wasn't in the recipe. In 2002, FDA inspectors found it in Kraft's plants, so the slices couldn't be called cheese food anymore.

art.desc: A thick old book lying open: the rules
A hand pressing a rubber stamp onto a sheet: the FDA

scenes.line: Kraft didn't take the powder out. It changed the name instead, to "cheese product." That name has no recipe at all.

art.desc: A pen on a blank label: the new name

scenes.line: So Kraft kept the powder, and dropped the word "food."

art.desc: A stack of individually wrapped cheese slices, the top one half unwrapped (Short 08's last picture)

scenes.line: And why do we say "trick or treat"? That's another story.

art.desc: A jack-o'-lantern bucket full of wrapped candy

scenes.beat_note: The tease: Short 10 is trick or treat.
